jobs.title: Techniker/in Wärmebehandlung (m/f/d)
jobs.description:

Mit unserem unternehmensweiten, systematischen Qualitätsmanagement optimieren wir kontinuierlich unsere Geschäftsprozesse und schaffen nachhaltigen Mehrwert für unsere Kunden. Ready to shape the future of finance in an international SAP S/4HANA environment? As a Group Finance Specialist & SAP FI Key User, you will support our international entities in accounting, closing and SAP finance-related topics. Working closely with Group Functions, local finance teams and IT, you will drive the harmonization and continuous improvement of our SAP FI processes while contributing to digitalization and process optimization initiatives. This role is ideal for a finance professional with solid accounting experience, hands-on SAP FI expertise and a passion for working at the intersection of finance, technology and international collaboration. Your Tasks:
• Support international group companies in accounting, closing, reporting and SAP FI-related questions, including variance analyses and data quality reviews in accordance with Swiss GAAP FER
• Act as a first point of contact for SAP finance support cases, analyze and resolve standard or recurring issues, and coordinate more complex topics with local finance teams, IT and SAP support
• Perform recurring SAP FI activities such as maintenance of SAP finance master data, period opening/closing, FX rates, SAP FI authorizations and user roles
• Support and continuously improve SAP FI processes within the international finance organization, with a focus on practical usability, process quality and harmonization
• Analyze, harmonize and document finance processes and SAP applications as part of digitalization and efficiency initiatives
• Provide guidance, training and hands-on support to local finance teams in accounting and SAP finance-related topics, including occasional international business travel (approx. 1–2 weeks per year) Your profile:
• Completed training or continuing education in finance and accounting (e.g., Finance and Accounting Specialist with a Federal Certificate) with relevant professional experience
• Very good knowledge of SAP FI, ideally supplemented by experience as a key user in an SAP S/4HANA environment
• Good understanding of accounting processes and their implementation in IT and ERP systems
• Strong analytical skills and a structured, independent, and solution-oriented approach to work
• Excellent communication skills and a passion for collaborating with diverse stakeholders in an international environment
• Very good written and spoken English skills, as well as a willingness to take occasional international business trips (approx. 1–2 weeks per year) We offer:

descriptionByLocale.en:

• Good understanding of accounting processes and their implementation in IT and ERP systems
• Strong analytical skills and a structured, independent, and solution-oriented approach to work

• Six weeks of vacation & the option to purchase additional vacation days
• Annual profit-sharing

• Staff cafeteria with attractive prices

• Bon relationnel, aisance communicationnelle et sens commercial
• Résidence proche de l'un des points de ventes We offer:
• Conditions d’emploi attractives et cadre de travail dynamique
• Horaires en semaine, du lundi au vendredi

• Une entreprise tournée vers l’avenir avec des opportunités d’évolution interne

• Durchführen von Wartungs-, Inspektions- und Instandhaltungsarbeiten
• Mitarbeit bei der Optimierung von Anlagen und Prozessen

• Fundierte Kenntnisse im elektrotechnischen und/oder mechanischen Bereich, sowie Praxiserfahrung in der Instandhaltung von Produktionsanlagen
• Erfahrung in der Fehlersuche und Störungsbehebung an elektrischen, pneumatischen und hydraulischen Systemen
